Population increased in Cheshire West and Chester

The estimated population of Cheshire West and Chester in 2024 was 371,652 usual residents, a rise of 1.4% since 2023.

This meant that Cheshire West and Chester's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Cheshire West and Chester increased by 3.9%.

Over this slightly longer period, Cheshire West and Chester was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Cheshire West and Chester

The average (median) age fell to 43.4 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Cheshire West and Chester has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Cheshire West and Chester is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Cheshire West and Chester's population of 371,652 usual residents was made up of:

  • 63,122 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17%)
  • 228,247 people aged 16 to 64 years, (61.4%)
  • 80,283 people aged 65 years and over, (21.6%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Cheshire West and Chester has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (21.6% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Cheshire West and Chester, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Cheshire West and Chester
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Cheshire West and Chester, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 698 people (-0.2%). In total, there were 3,116 births and 3,814 deaths in Cheshire West and Chester.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 2,652 (0.7%). There were 19,076 people entering the area and 16,424 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Cheshire West and Chester's population of 3,107 (0.8%) as a result of 4,512 people entering the area and 1,405 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Cheshire West and Chester was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Cheshire West and Chester in mid-2023 is 366,665.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 1,311 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 293 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,604 people.
